title: Refinement comparison square
statement: Let $f:X'\to X$ be a scheme morphism, let $U$ and $U'$ be arbitrary open covers, and let refine be a specified index map with $U'_i\subseteq f^{-1}(U_{\mathrm{refine}(i)})$. For a quasi-coherent module $F$ and $n\ge 0$, let gamma be any cochain map satisfying the tuplewise refinement formula [def-sc-cech-refinement-cochain-map], and let c and c' be the canonical comparisons [def-sc-module-cech-comparison] for F and its pullback. Then the refinement homology map, transported through the forgetting-scalars homology isomorphisms, followed by c' equals c followed by the usual module-cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No comparison is required to be invertible.

proof.text: Choose the already-defined resolution data computing moduleCohomologyPullback. Apply the resolution diagram lemma to obtain its two total-homology squares. Evaluate both IsModuleCechComparison equations at the respective resolutions and map them through forgetting scalars. Cancel the composite of the target resolution identification and H(alpha), which is an isomorphism for U-prime. Substitute the beta square, source comparison equation, and alpha square. Finally expand the existing resolution formula and cancel the target resolution identification with its inverse; the private resolution_map_postcompose proves this algebraic cancellation.

theorem cechRefinement_comparison_square (X X' : Scheme.{v}) (f : X' ⟶ X)
    {ι ι' : Type v} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
    (U' : ι' → X'.Opens) (hU' : iSup U' = ⊤)
    (refine : ι' → ι) (hrefine : ∀ i, U' i ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U (refine i))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ)
    (cF : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).homology p ⟶
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F)
    (hcF : IsModuleCechComparison U F p cF)
    (cF' : ((cechComplexFunctor U').obj
        ((tensorPullback f).obj F).presheafModuleCat).homology p ⟶
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p).obj ((tensorPullback f).obj F))
    (hcF' : IsModuleCechComparison U' ((tensorPullback f).obj F) p cF')
    (gamma : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v} Γ(X', ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          ((cechComplexFunctor U').obj ((tensorPullback f).obj F).presheafModuleCat))
    (hgamma : IsCechRefinementMap f U U' refine hrefine F gamma)
 :
    cechRefinementHomology gamma p ≫ (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map cF' =
      (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map cF ≫ moduleCohomologyPullback f F p
